summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine open-market share repurchase of 320,663 ordinary shares at an average price of 11.2080 GBP per share, executed via JP Morgan. The shares will be cancelled, reducing total shares in issue to 2,522,407,333. This buyback is conducted under shareholder authority from the 2025 AGM and an arrangement announced on 6 January 2026. The filing is a standard transactional disclosure under UK Listing Rules and Hong Kong Code; it does not represent a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or other event-driven strategic change.
